title: Yaya's Beach Carriage | 30a Vacation Rental | 30a Beach Properties – 30A Beach Properties
meta_description: A minute from the beach, Yaya's Beach Carriage is a can't-miss 30a vacation rental for your next vacation. Click here to learn more and book a stay of your own!
description_expanded:
This stunning Rosemary Beach location is only a one-minute walk to the beach, Western Green, and Main Street cafes. Close to boardwalk F, the carriage fronts the estate lot section of Rosemary Beach.

Note: Loft stairs not suitable for ages six or under.

All towels, bed linens, blankets, comforters, and pillow/mattress protectors are professionally laundered for every new reservation!

We provide passes to access all 4 Rosemary Beach Community pools, and any of the 9 Beach Walkovers

Guests should be comfortable with the artistic ladder stairs to the loft - a common feature in many early designed Rosemary carriage houses (please review photos).

This large corner lot carriage home offers balconies from which to take in gulf views. Yaya's carriage offers an open living and dining table area, full bath with shower, and a well-appointed full kitchen with a wrap-around bar counter. An alternating staircase leads to a loft bedroom with a queen bed, plus a twin bed with pull out trundle. Your reserved parking space is located in the garage along with the dedicated carriage washer/dryer.
